text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having learned the thickness of the global 
wall, she put in tireless effort to face 
down formidable foes. And now, the day of 
the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe had arrived—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Starting with Speed Symboli's very first 
challenge, they have made it this far 
thanks to the project members who shared 
that ambition and the support of the fans.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now all of Japan stands united, cheering <chrname> 
on. The romantic dream of reaching the 
pinnacle of the world pushes her forward.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The time has come— The Prix de l'Arc de 
Triomphe, where the purest hearts seeking 
to be the world's best clash, begins now.
